title: Anchorage Chillhop 🚆
description:
Departing daily: live train rides around the world, 24/7 → youtube.com/@LofiTrainPOV/streams

Settle into a window seat for a quiet train ride through illustrated Alaska near Anchorage: vast snow-covered mountains glowing in low golden winter light under a bright blue sky as light snow drifts past, set to mellow chillhop the whole way.

Lofi Train POV: cozy illustrated train-window journeys through the world's cities, set to relaxing chillhop. A new city every day. Sit back, look out the window, and stay as long as you like.

Stylised illustrated artwork; not real footage.
Music: "Hot Chocolate" and "Disassociate" by Purrple Cat (purrplecat.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were trimmed and cross-faded.
